Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

If the Level (in Pay Matrix) of the ex cadre post is higher than that of the parent cadre post, an increment shall be given in the Level (in Pay Matrix) of parent cadre post and he/she shall be placed at a Cell equal to the figure so arrived at in the Level (in Pay Matrix) of the ex cadre post; and if no such Cell is available in the Level (in Pay Matrix) of the ex cadre post, he/she shall be placed at the next higher cell In that Level.
